title: Praxis Special Education: Early Childhood/Early Intervention (5692) - 200 Source Questions + 300 Independent Practice Questions
description: Contains 200 original source questions, 300 assistant-authored independent practice questions, and 0 source-derived guided-review activities. The assistant audit found 457 distinct independent content kernels. Two 100-item diagnostics, an exact-blueprint 120-item timed simulation, targeted feedback, and a native learning library for birth-through-age-eight early intervention and early childhood special education practice.
contentReview: Assistant audit completed: 500 independent-practice items contain 457 distinct content kernels and 43 parallel variants under the normalized test. 0 additional activities are guided reasoning transformations, not independent exam questions. The 500-distinct-question target is not met.
disclaimer: Independent preparation material, not affiliated with or endorsed by ETS. Results are not official forms, scaled scores, pass predictions, licenses, screenings, diagnoses, eligibility or placement decisions, legal advice, or substitutes for current federal, state, local, tribal, or program requirements.
